À afficher dans un endroit visible de to: To display where everyone can see them: copies of each instructor's diplomas and professional cards, the establishment's liability insurance certificate, and the health and safety rules for the activities offered.
On y ajoute en pratique : le règlement i: In practice you also add: the internal rules, prices and opening hours, emergency numbers.
Une trousse de secours pour les premiers: A first aid kit (check expiry dates), a way to alert emergency services quickly (landline or mobile with signal), and an emergency chart on display: addresses and numbers of the fire brigade, ambulance service, police and vet.
L'établissement doit être assuré en resp: The establishment must have liability insurance covering its managers, instructors, employees and the riders who practise there. The certificate is displayed.
Toute personne payée pour enseigner l'éq: Anyone paid to teach riding must hold a state-recognised diploma and an up-to-date professional card (French Sports Code, art. L. 212-1 and following). Employing someone without a diploma is punishable by law.
Honorabilité : une personne condamnée po: Good character: a person convicted of certain offences may neither coach nor run a sports establishment (art. L. 212-9 and L. 322-1).
Tout accident grave, ou toute situation: Any serious accident, or any situation that seriously endangers riders, must be reported to the prefect, through the department's youth and sports service, on the official form, within 48 hours. The head of the establishment makes the report.
Dès le premier salarié (apprenti compris: From the first employee (apprentices included), the employer writes the risk assessment document: the risks of each job (falls, kicks, heavy loads, hay dust, tractor…) and what is done to reduce them.
Il se met à jour à chaque changement imp: It is updated after every major change, and at least once a year from 11 employees. It is kept for 40 years.
Là où l'on stocke des matières qui brûle: Wherever easily flammable materials are stored (hay, straw, shavings, fuel), the employer must write and display fire safety instructions, whatever the size of the yard: the extinguishers, who is in charge, who leads the evacuation, how to raise the alarm, the fire brigade's number. They are sent to the labour inspectorate.
Un plan d'évacuation affiché et un exerc: A displayed evacuation plan and an evacuation drill every 6 months are recommended (INRS). All staff learn to use the extinguishers.
Un bâtiment où entre du public (club-hou: A building the public enters (clubhouse, indoor school, stands) may be classed as an establishment open to the public. Then: extinguishers checked every year, evacuation plan displayed, safety register recording the checks.
Les règles exactes dépendent de la catég: The exact rules depend on the building's category (number of people received): ask your town hall or the fire brigade's prevention service.
Dès le premier salarié : le registre uni: From the first employee: the single staff register (all employees, trainees included, in order of hiring), and the employment law notices (labour inspectorate, occupational health, collective agreement, working hours, no smoking…).
Le GHN fournit des modèles prêts à impri: The GHN provides ready-to-print templates for equestrian establishments.
La personne qui s'occupe du lieu où vive: The person in charge of the place where the horses live registers with the IFCE and keeps the 7-part holding register: everything is in "The register" in My yard, ready to print.
Les papiers d'identification de chaque c: The identification papers of each horse present are kept at the yard.
Au-delà de 65 km dans le cadre de l'acti: Beyond 65 km as part of the business: transport authorisation, the driver's CAPTAV certificate and transport log. Everything is tracked in "The lorry".
Depuis la loi de 2021 contre la maltrait: Since the 2021 animal welfare law, a private individual who buys or receives an equine signs a certificate of commitment and knowledge of the animal's needs. The horse can only be handed over 7 days after signing: the seller checks it has been done.
Quand on vend des cours, des stages ou d: When you sell lessons, clinics or livery to private individuals, you must join an approved consumer mediator and give customers its details (contracts, website, terms of sale).
